# KloofStreet.online

> The curated digital guide to Kloof Street, Gardens, Cape Town — voted #22 World's Coolest Street (Time Out 2025). Verified business listings, an AI concierge, and the Street Pass loyalty programme.

Site: https://www.kloofstreet.online
Owner platform: Business Hustle (businesshustle.co.za)
Merchant backoffice: https://www.hustleportal.online/ (free account includes R99 lead credits)

## Core pages
- [Directory](https://www.kloofstreet.online/directory): 51+ verified Kloof Street businesses — curated, not crowded.
- [AI Concierge](https://www.kloofstreet.online/ai-concierge): real-time recommendations for dining, wellness and itineraries.
- [Street Pass](https://www.kloofstreet.online/streetpass): R199/month loyalty membership — scan QR codes, earn points, redeem rewards at partner stores.
- [Get Listed](https://www.kloofstreet.online/get-listed): how businesses join the platform.
- [For Business](https://www.kloofstreet.online/merchant): merchant gateway — sign in to HustlePortal for the backoffice (newsletters, contacts, pipeline, payments, AI tools).

## About the platform
KloofStreet.online is the digital layer of Kloof Street — one of Cape Town's most famous
high streets in the Gardens neighbourhood at the foot of Table Mountain. The site is a
curated directory (not an open listing): every business is verified by the Business Hustle
team. Tourists and locals use it to discover where to eat, train, heal, shop and explore;
businesses run their backoffice (newsletter, contacts, payments, pipeline, AI lead-finder)
on HustlePortal at https://www.hustleportal.online/.

## Street Pass (loyalty programme)
Members pay R199/month, get a membership pass (Apple/Google Wallet supported), scan QR
codes at partner stores to earn points, and redeem points for rewards. Merchants verify
check-ins and redemptions through their HustlePortal-connected tools.

## PWA
This is an installable app: add it to your home screen for offline access to the full
directory, business profiles and concierge info.
